set.body:
Defect: D1/D2. FilmFest's +106 is an ORDINAL remap of coarse segment numbers restarting in run 2 (filmfest_annotation.py:14-16,:36-37), not a clock offset -- revision 1 wrongly made it a clock-slice exit criterion. And ordinals have no home in core's mapping apparatus at all: ClockRepair.of demands two PresentationAxisIds, a segment-number space is not an axis, and inventedEditionPlayback refuses outright.

Do: DECIDE with two corpora of evidence in hand (Friends and FilmFestival), not before: is SegmentLink that home, or does MappingFamily gain a fourth case beside ClockRepair / TrackComposition / EditionCorrespondence? Record in the ADR.

Exit: The decision is recorded with its evidence. Related: bd-01M199ABAG5SXR9C6Y0G4X6J2T (amend movie time and mapping contract).

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md S2 'Film Festival's +106'
set.title: intake P3 DECISION: where ordinal remaps live
